game.title: Snakes & Ladders
game.tagline: Lagos Edition. Enter BRT, avoid go-slow!

game.howto.1.text: Tap di dice (or press Space) make e roll. Your pawn go hop as many squares as di dice show. Who reach square 100 first, na him win.

game.howto.2.text: If you land for di foot of ladder (BRT, okada, keke or bridge), you go ride up. If you land for pothole, go-slow, NEPA or toll queue, you go slide go down.

game.howto.3.text: You must roll di exact number to land for 100. If e too big, you go stay where you dey (you fit change am for Rules).

game.howto.4.text: One time for each game, you fit use Re-roll after you don see wetin you roll. You must keep di new one.

game.howto.5.text: Every 5th turn, you go roll two dice and keep one. Tap one dice, or press 1 or 2.

game.howto.6.text: If you dey use keyboard: Space or Enter na to roll and move, R na to re-roll, P or Esc na to pause. Di computer players dey follow di same rules.

rules.title: Rules
rules.note: Di computer players dey follow di same rules as you.
rules.exact.help: You must land for 100 exactly. If e too big, you go stay put.
rules.reroll.help: One time for each game, you fit throw away your roll and roll again.
rules.choice.help: Roll two dice and keep di one wey you like.
board.label: Game board wey get 100 squares
play.yourTurn: Your turn. Tap di dice make e roll.
play.yourTurnTwo: Two dice this turn o! Tap di dice make e roll.
play.decide: You roll {n}. You wan move, or you go use your re-roll?
play.pick: Pick one dice: tap am, or press 1 or 2.
